name: CLARA executable-specification extension v2
status: Prospective analysis specification for this revision; not a public preregistration
original_results_status: The original manuscript reports 330 contrasts and a 120-question stress test. Its raw artifacts were not supplied. New snapshot results must not be represented as a replication of that registry or parser.
inclusion: Every listed cohort-gene combination; all executable interpretations with nonempty denominators. Retain genes with zero recorded mutations. No result-based filtering.
denominator_estimand: Profiled prevalence is conditional on at least one eligible profiled sample. Cohort-denominator observed-positive fraction is a lower bound, not an unbiased prevalence estimator. Numerators always require mutation-profile membership and the selected specimen context.
benchmarks: Four one-axis contrasts at the reference interpretation
Eight broad-scope interpretations for denominator-context-unit interactions
verification: Independent SQLite DISTINCT-count and pandas set-aggregation execution. Compare numerator, denominator, profiled-unit count, and prevalence for every interpretation. Also test empty denominators, duplicated records, multiple specimens, context intersection, noncoding exclusion, and unprofiled positives.
planner: Dynamic program minimizing expected clarification questions under a uniform prior over the enumerated interpretations. Stop only when all remaining interpretations are within both primary tolerances. Unit question costs; no user study. Compare against all 24 fixed field orders and always clarify all four fields.
new_language_evaluation: None. Do not manufacture parser evaluation results or treat generated questions as independent researcher queries.
independence: Four additional TCGA cohorts are cohort extensions within the same resource and schema, not independent-resource validation.
statistical_units: Cohort-gene family, not individual interpretations or hypothetical dialogue traces. Report descriptive rates; any resampling must retain all interpretations within a family and acknowledge the small number of cohorts.
negative_results: Report all cohorts and all planner comparisons regardless of whether they improve performance. Do not tune tolerances or gene lists on outcomes.
